node.statement: Put delta_prime=C_m*e as supplied by node 1.2. For e small enough that delta_prime+epsilon is below the universal threshold in lem-extcb-one-dimensional-corner-dimension, that external applies to the one-dimensional delta_prime-projection R_a and the one-dimensional delta-projection Q (enlarge the common projection-accuracy parameter to max{delta_prime,delta}). It gives d_a:=dim S_{R_a,Q}<=1. Since d_a is a nonnegative integer, d_a is 0 or 1.
